passages.quote: Emperor Wu initiated a calendar reform and, in 104 BCE, ordered the astronomers Deng Ping 鄧平 and Luoxia Hong 落下閎 (156-87) to supervise it

passages.locator: Section on the calendars of the Qin and Han
passages.quote: The Taichu Calendar was in use for 188 years before it was replaced in 85 CE by the Sifen Calendar.
